sous-titre: IFDD · International Organisation of La Francophonie
intro: Add Guide Négo to your phone's home screen: it then opens like an app, and everything readable reads without a connection.
avant-la-salle: Open the app once with a network connection before relying on it in the room: that first opening is what stores everything on the phone.

android.etape-3-precision: The Guide Négo icon appears among your apps.

iphone.etape: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
